The image features a massive parabolic dish antenna composed of an intricate lattice or mesh framework rather than solid panels. A heavy truss support structure backs the dish, and a receiver cabin/feed assembly is visible near the focal point. The background shows a cloudy sky and a distant tree line, emphasizing the scale of the instrument.
